reason: All explicitly named characters in this text have elevated or special roles and are not regular people: Ahab (אַחְאָב) is a king; Jezebel (אִיזֶבֶל) is a queen; Elijah (אֵלִיָּהוּ) is a prophet; Elisha (אֱלִישָׁע) is called to become a prophet; and Shaphat (שָׁפָט) appears only in patronymic form as Elisha's father.
